purpose: Original scene/chamber mockups; not gameplay screenshots or final surface textures

concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a SINGLE wide 16:9 environment scene mockup for a playable low-poly haunted castle ghost-train level. Primary request: a highly polished, richly dressed indoor loading foyer and execution-gallery reveal inspired by the 2002 Scooby-Doo Spooky Island castle ride. Reference images: the production drawings establish irregular polygonal room shapes, inset turret details, pointed heavy iron doors and whimsical crooked castle proportions; the official ride photo establishes burgundy/gold molded monster-front cars and theatrical magenta/blue/amber lighting; the five-model sheet establishes the actual game's existing low-poly knight, arch and food sculpture vocabulary. Make an ORIGINAL scene, do not reproduce logos or film characters. Camera: plausible gameplay eye about 3m high, looking down a 3m-clear traversable rail route, floor landing edges and the entire pointed gateway visible. Foreground left: a compact OPEN ride car with a large mischievous carved demon face, brass edging, dark burgundy panels, four believable wheels, interior visible; a second car ahead on steel rails. Middle ground: a huge grotesque carved face portal with an open mouth doorway and one ornate skull-headed swinging axe suspended visibly from an iron pivot. Dense sculptural stonework, inset alcoves with green-eyed suits of armour, irregular buttresses, crooked pointed doors with rivets, leaded insect-wing windows, low iron railings, tarnished brass sconces, torn velvet banners and sparse cobwebs. Closed ceiling with intersecting pointed stone ribs and a sculpted bronze candle chandelier. Controlled blue floor light, crimson wall wash, warm amber highlight on cart and axe, green eye emission. Hand-painted textures on clearly faceted LOW-POLY 3D models; sophisticated composition, depth, contact shadows, restrained mist. Not a photograph, not a generic empty brick corridor, not a smooth high-poly rendering. No HUD, text, captions, watermark, or split panels.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a SINGLE wide 16:9 environment scene mockup for a playable low-poly ghost-train castle banquet chamber. Primary request: a richly staged original haunted banquet scene evoking the grotesque dinner animatronics and gothic theatrical production design of Scooby-Doo Spooky Island (2002). Use the original castle production plan for irregular octagonal/rounded chamber proportions, different wall angles, inset pointed window recesses and small mock-castle turrets; use the existing Meshy model sheet to retain the EXACT playful roasted-turkey monster, tiered red-and-cream toothy cake monster and green-eyed armoured knight style. No film characters/logos. Composition: camera at a plausible gameplay eye around 3m, a readable gently curving twin rail / narrow wooden serving-runway line occupies bottom center and leads across a staged reveal; keep takeoff/landing surfaces clearly visible. One intimate OCTAGONAL grand dining chamber, NOT an extremely long corridor of identical tables. Foreground: richly carved oak feast table with grotesque beast legs, burgundy scalloped velvet runner trimmed in aged gold, bronze platters/goblets/candleholders, a large original Meshy-like cake animatronic leaning toward the path, exposed tiny camshaft under its platter. Mid-left: the roasted-turkey monster with clawed wings/fanged mouth emerging from a brass platter under a red spotlight. Rear: a raised U-shaped feast dais, menacing suits of armour in close niches, gigantic grotesque carved stone fireplace/face doorway and tall crooked pointed doors. A low sculpted bronze chandelier dominates the upper frame, crumbling asymmetrical stone ribs, insect-wing leaded windows, rich copper stone accents, cobwebs and worn checker/flagstone flooring. Cool blue rim and red wall washes, warm candle/brass pools, tiny spectral-green eyes. High-fidelity HAND-PAINTED low-poly 3D game art: broad expressive geometry, visibly faceted sculptural models, dense but deliberately composed props, excellent contact shadows, clear gameplay negative space. No bland cubes, no floating food, no generic stone tunnel, no photoreal people, no HUD, lettering, captions, watermark, or collage.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a SINGLE wide 16:9 environment scene mockup for a playable low-poly haunted castle ride's shattered railway and mechanical crypt. Primary request: a spectacular original indoor ghost-train chamber that evokes Scooby-Doo Spooky Island's playful gothic mechanical traps and oversized carved-face portals. Reference production plans show irregular polygonal chambers, different levels, steep pointed studded doors, inset alcoves and crooked theatrical castle profiles. Retain the existing low-poly green-eyed knight and cart sculpture style from the model sheet. Camera is an achievable gameplay view about 4m above the safe near ledge, floor/takeoff edge visible. Foreground bottom: an intact stone landing and twin steel rails changing into a clearly suspended, broken railway; three separated grindable rail sections curve over a dark indoor abyss with SMALL jump breaks, not an impossible missing bridge. All rails have hand-painted wooden sleepers, sculpted iron trestles and diagonal braces beneath, broken splinters and bent rail ends. Mid-right: a large bronze/iron clockwork mechanism with toothed wheels, exposed axle and hanging counterweight, visibly powering a compact moving ghost cart on a side track. Mid-left: a close green-eyed armoured knight on a ruined ledge, mechanically menacing rather than human-like. Rear focal point: colossal monstrous carved stone face portal, open mouth aligned to the receiving rail, emerald light within; asymmetric balconies and cracked stone buttresses layered behind it. Dense, distinctive hand-painted Meshy-like low-poly castle masonry, coffin/gargoyle details, crooked vaulted ceiling and suspended bronze chandelier, torn dark crimson banners and cobwebs. Cinematic cool cyan/blue edge light on rails, magenta/red masonry light, warm brass machine pool and spectral-green portal; controlled mist, deep visible silhouettes, convincing contact shadows. High fidelity low-poly 3D game environment, NOT a realistic photograph and NOT a simple box corridor. Clear traversal path and jumps, no HUD, text, branding, watermark, characters from the film, or multiple panels.
